Why Comitia

We work with governments and electoral bodies, adapting each solution to the legal framework, logistics and specific challenges of every process.

How we work

Platforms built for real-world contexts

Designed to work in the field, with the connectivity, climate and scale each election day demands.

Implementation and institutional support

We support electoral authorities before, during and after the election, with training and on-site assistance.

Security, traceability and real-time data

Solutions

An ecosystem for the entire electoral cycle.

Six solutions covering in-person and remote voting, polling station management, vote counting, logistics operations and voter information.

View all solutions

BUEElectronic Single Ballot

Electronic Single Ballot system for in-person elections. It combines the speed of electronic voting with the backing of a physical ballot.
View details

NoteboxComprehensive polling station management

Comprehensive management system for a polling station that digitizes operations end to end.
View details

TuringVote counting and tabulation

Electoral technology for vote counting and results tabulation, traceable from each polling station to the final result.
View details

InvoteOnline voting

Online voting software for remote elections. It enables secure, auditable voting from anywhere.
View details

Electoral OperationsElectoral Operations System

System for centralizing information and monitoring electoral processes, to coordinate logistics in real time.

Tools to inform voters and prepare election teams.

COMITIA supports Paraguay’s electoral process with its technological infrastructure

Through the deployment of more than 18,000 voting machines and mission-critical software, COMITIA MSA continues to support Paraguay’s electoral process for the sixth consecutive year, contributing to an election involving more than 4.6 million voters in Paraguay and abroad.
